resources.string: Capture needs the camera and microphone

To film and to record sound, Android asks you to allow the camera and the microphone. Joy Creator also asks to show the recording notice, so you always know when it is recording. Nothing leaves your phone.
Capture stays closed until the camera and microphone are allowed. Tap Capture again any time.
Android will not ask again for the camera or microphone. Turn them on in Joy Creator\'s settings page under Permissions, then come back.
This is how the notice looks while Joy Creator records. It always says what is happening and always has a Stop button.
